rationale: This additive Experience correction implements the existing Runtime-truth and health-separation contracts without changing constitutional meaning. The browser now requests one fixed, read-only bootstrap contract instead of fanning out independent reads across autoscaled Gateway processes. The receiving Gateway validates and scope-admits one current Runtime-owned Capability Registry projection, reuses that exact admitted projection for every fixed child alias, and performs the existing reads with concurrency bounded to three. Per-route capability admission, response validation, size limits, tenant and workspace binding, read-only behavior, independent failure envelopes, and fail-closed posture remain intact. A structurally valid process-ready /ready 503 remains one Degraded result without retry; malformed or unauthorized Registry responses prevent all child dispatch. No generic proxy, mutation route, Authority, Runtime change, capability promotion, production claim, deployment, or historical Mission record mutation is introduced.
